Hi Karthik,

Marissa / Rafael — forwarding an ask from EnterpriseCo. They want a private offer on AWS Marketplace with a 20% first-year discount on a ~$750k ARR commit. They prefer Marketplace flow for procurement speed.

Quick context: this is an expansion from a pilot (they are already on a small hosted plan, ~15k/mo). Win here triggers co-sell engagement from the AWS Partner team (cc'd) and could unlock a larger co-sell pipeline in Q3. If we lose the Marketplace option, procurement will likely push us to another vendor.

Asks:
- Can Deal Desk approve a 20% off list private offer for this deal? If not, what is the maximum standard private-offer discount allowed?
- If an exception is possible, I need a draft approval + the required margin & legal signoffs so I can circulate to procurement.

Thanks for the context, Karthik. I reviewed the numbers and attached a quick pricing impact calc. A few items before Deal Desk can greenlight an exception:

- Requested discount (20%) would exceed standard private-offer guardrails for this tier. Our default ceiling for marketplace private offers at this ARR band is 15% without Senior Approval.
- We need margin impact, expected ARR recognition cadence, and whether there's a pre-paid vs. invoiced cadence. Please confirm whether EnterpriseCo will pre-pay year 1 (preferred) or run monthly billing.
- Legal needs to confirm any marketplace T&C implications; loop Legal if any bespoke terms are expected.
- Confirm co-sell commitment from AWS (partner rep is cc'd) — co-sell approval would make a stronger case.

If you can confirm prepayment + AWS co-sell, I can escalate to Vivek for a one-off approval to move to 20%. Otherwise, the maximum I can authorize without leadership is 15%.

Attachments: pricing-impact-20260516.xlsx

--Marissa Cole
Head of Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com; marcus_lin@redwood.com; rafael_mendes@redwood.com; aws-partner-account-manager@amazon.com
Date: 2026-05-18 17:30 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Approval needed for 20% private offer to close EnterpriseCo (time-sensitive)

Vivek — escalating for approval. Short summary:

- Account: EnterpriseCo (large fintech; regulatory workload)
- Ask: Approve a one-time 20% private-offer discount on AWS Marketplace for Year 1 to secure a $750k ARR commitment (anticipated $600k recognized in year 1 if pre-paid).
- Business rationale: Procurement requires Marketplace purchase for compliance. AWS co-sell rep is engaged and has indicated sales motion support if we can get the private offer live this week. Losing Marketplace option will delay procurement by months and likely push them to a competitor that has a faster marketplace workflow.
- Financials: With 20% off, blended unit economics remain acceptable for Year 1 provided EnterpriseCo agrees to pre-pay; Deal Desk attached a pricing impact spreadsheet.

Requested decision: Approve or deny the 20% private-offer exception by EOD Tuesday (48 hours). If approved, Marissa will produce approval memo and list required margin/legal signoffs for Marketplace listing. I have included the customer's PO draft and HubSpot deal link.

Attachments: EnterpriseCo_PO_Draft.pdf; pricing-impact-20260516.xlsx; hubspot-deal-2345.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2345; https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/solutions/private-offer/offer-987654

Thanks for the quick read — happy to jump on a 15 min call if helpful.
